FOR HIGH SCHOOL · COLLEGE

G11 搭素材，G12 上考场。G11 builds the stories. G12 walks into the room.

先把故事讲顺，再上真场。Get the stories straight, then walk into the room.

同一套系统，按阶段给出不同的练法。G11 把经历练成经得起三层追问的故事；G12 按申请截止日倒排 InitialView 和校友面试；美高生按“美高生能约到的面试”来练；大学生练研究生和实习面试。

One system, different plans. Juniors build stories that survive three rounds of follow-ups, seniors work back from deadlines, US high-schoolers practice the interviews actually open to them, and college students prep for grad school and internships.

硕士、博士、Kira 视频和实习面试，考的都是同一件事：能不能把一段经历讲具体、讲出你本人做了什么、讲出数字。先用练习模式把 3 个核心故事练顺，再用实战模式完整走一遍。

Grad school, PhD, Kira and internship interviews all test the same thing: specific stories, your own role, real numbers. Drill three core stories in Practice mode, then run the full thing in Real mode.

G11 · JUNIOR素材期 Build

把经历练成故事Turn experiences into stories

  • 每月一场 InitialView 全流程预演同一位面试官、同一套评分，成长档案记录每次的分数变化。One full InitialView run each month, tracked over time.
  • 三个经得起追问的故事每个故事准备三层：具体做了什么、难在哪里、现在怎么看。Three stories, each ready for three layers of follow-up.
  • 夏校与科研项目面试春季项目申请前专项练，顺便把学术兴趣讲清楚。Summer and research program interviews before spring deadlines.
  • Why US 专项在动笔写主文书之前，先把“为什么来美国”说成自己的话。Say "why the U.S." in your own words before you write the essay.
G12 · SENIOR冲刺期 Sprint

按截止日倒排面试Work back from your deadlines

按 InitialView 2026 规则估算（只跳过周末，不含节假日）：标准 10 个工作日出结果，加急 5 / 2 个工作日（+$55 / +$125）；重考须与上次间隔至少 14 天，新一场覆盖旧场；改期须提前 3 天并付 $95。具体以各校要求的材料截止日为准。ED/EA 提交后，校友面试多在 11 月至次年 2 月陆续邀约。
Estimates use InitialView's 2026 rules: results in 10 business days (5 or 2 with expedite), retakes at least 14 days apart. Always check each college's own deadline.

  • 学校库切到“美国高中”直接看哪些学校给美高生面试（哈佛、普林斯顿、MIT、杜克、乔治城…），哪些改交视频。See which colleges interview US high-schoolers and which want a video.

  • 视频自我介绍类 Glimpse 的 60–90 秒一镜到底，给不面试美高生的学校准备。Glimpse-style 60–90 s one-take videos.

THE INITIALVIEW GUIDE · 2026

InitialView，一次讲清楚。Everything you need to know about InitialView.

InitialView（初鉴）是中国学生申请美本最常用的第三方面试：一段 12–15 分钟的真人即兴对话，加一篇 20 分钟受监考的英文写作。不打分，你先看录像，再决定发给哪些学校。下面按“是什么、怎么约、规则、递送、区别、准备、常见问题”整理，另附 43 场师说学员真实面试的提问实录和 36 道真实写作题。

InitialView is the third-party interview most Chinese applicants send to US colleges: a 12–15 minute live, unscripted conversation plus a 20-minute proctored writing sample. Nothing is scored. You watch it first, then choose where to send it. Includes question logs from 43 real sessions and 36 real writing prompts.

12–15分钟真人即兴对话min live interview
20分钟受监考写作min proctored writing
$265面试 + 笔试标准价interview + writing
10个工作日出结果business days to results

整理自 InitialView 官网与师说《InitialView 介绍与准备指南（2026 版）》，以官网实时页面为准。Compiled from initialview.com and CMC's 2026 InitialView guide; the official site is the final word.

SCHOOL BY SCHOOL · 2026–27

哪些学校还面试，都问什么。Which colleges still interview, and what they ask.

逐一核对了 8 所藤校、TOP10 综合大学、TOP20 文理学院和乔治城的最新面试政策：谁来面、怎么约、大陆学生和美高生分别能不能拿到、是否接受 InitialView 或 Glimpse 视频，以及公开报告的题目。切换“我在”可以看大陆高中或美高的版本。

We checked the current interview policy at every Ivy, the top national universities, the top liberal arts colleges and Georgetown: who interviews, how you get one, whether students in mainland China or at US high schools can, whether InitialView or Glimpse counts, and the questions people report.

政策核对于 2026 年 10 月，来源为各校招生官网与公开面经（每校附链接）；学校每年可能调整，以官网为准。Checked October 2026 against each college's admissions site; policies change, so confirm on the official page.

UK G5 · 英国本科面试 UNDERGRADUATE INTERVIEWS

牛剑、帝国理工、UCL、LSE，按专业练面试。Oxford, Cambridge, Imperial, UCL and LSE, subject by subject.

英国名校的面试是学术面试：导师给你一道题、一段文本或一组数据，看你怎么边想边说、怎么接住提示和反驳。这里按学校和专业整理了 2027 入学的面试安排、笔试和 2,300 多道题，题目来自官网、学院、导师公开的样题和往届考生回忆，每道题都标明出处和类型。每道题都能单独练，也可以按某个专业的面试形式完整模拟。

UK interviews are academic: a tutor gives you a problem, a text or some data and watches how you think aloud and respond to hints and pushback. Formats, tests and 2,300+ sourced questions for 2027 entry, by university and subject.

HK 8 · 香港本科面试 UNDERGRADUATE INTERVIEWS

港大、中大、科大、理大、城大、浸大、岭大、教大，按专业练面试。Hong Kong's eight public universities, programme by programme.

香港的面试形式差别很大：有一对一或二对一的个人面试，有 4–8 人的小组讨论，医科和兽医用 MMI，商科有时是录播视频。这里整理了 130 多个专业的面试安排（非联招 / 国际课程和内地生），以及 400 多道标明出处的真题和讨论题。小组讨论模拟时，AI 会扮演其他考生。

Formats differ a lot: individual panels, 4–8 person group discussions, MMIs for medicine and vet science, recorded video for some business programmes. Interview arrangements for 130+ programmes and 400+ sourced questions; in group practice the AI plays the other candidates.

高中生 10 种、大学生 5 种。每种面试的时长、节奏和追问方式都不同，先选场景，面试官会按这一场的真实流程来问。

HOW THE QUESTIONS GET HERE

题目来自真实面试，
追问来自你的回答。Questions come from real interviews. Follow-ups come from your answers.

InterviewLab.ai（CMC 师说留学出品）与 InitialView、Vericant、Kira Talent、Glimpse 及文中任何大学均无隶属或背书关系。模拟面试是基于公开招生流程与学员回忆真题的独立练习；院校政策以各校官网当年说明为准。CMC is not affiliated with or endorsed by InitialView, Vericant or any college named here.

STORY BANK · 故事素材库

三个故事，每个经得起三层追问。Three stories, each ready for three layers of follow-up.

面试官的问题千变万化，但追问总会落到你最核心的几段经历上。把每段经历写成“情境 → 你做了什么 → 结果 → 现在怎么看”，系统会告诉你面试官会怎么一层层追问，然后让你一个故事一个故事地练。

Questions vary, but follow-ups always land on your core experiences. Write each one as situation, what you did, result, reflection; see how an interviewer would dig in, then practice story by story.

STEP 02 · 面试间 THE ROOM

每个回答，都会被追问。Every answer gets a follow-up.

画面和 InitialView 真实录像一致：你占满整个画面，外教以一张真人照片出现在左侧，全程用自然的英文语音和你对话，没有动画。五位外教可选，照片已内置。外教先寒暄、确认能听清，然后正式开始。你直接开口回答，中间停下来想也不会被打断，说完点“我说完了”或按回车；它会点头、会说 “Mm-hm”，会顺着你刚才的话追问，回答太长也会礼貌地打断你。打开“教练旁注”，可以看到每次追问背后的原因。

The layout matches a real InitialView recording: you fill the frame and the interviewer appears as a photo with a natural voice. No cartoons. The interviewer opens with small talk and a sound check, then gets going. Answer out loud and take your time; tap Done or press Enter when you finish. It nods, says "mm-hm", builds the next question from what you just said, and will politely cut in if you run long.

STEP 03 · 反馈报告 THE REPORT

反馈，只写给你。Feedback written for you.

报告读完整场对话，把每个回答和这道题的高分答法对照打分；再用你自己的经历重写一遍，告诉你哪一处改动最能改变面试官的判断。

The report reads the whole conversation, grades each answer against a strong one for that question, rewrites it with your own material, and tells you the one change that would move the interviewer's verdict.

示例报告 SAMPLE · 虚构学生 LIN KE · G12 · INITIALVIEW

01 / 06

MY PROGRESS · 我的进步

每一场都算数，问题会越来越少。Every session counts. The same mistakes show up less.

每练完一场，分数、四个表达信号和每个回答的问题都会记在这台电脑上。这里看趋势、看你最常犯的问题，并针对它练一题；也可以把记录导出给顾问，再把顾问的批注导入回来。

Every session is saved on this computer. See your trend and recurring issues, practice the one that matters, and swap files with your counselor.

COUNSELOR · 顾问端

所有学生的练习，在一个地方批注。Every student's practice, annotated in one place.

导入学生发来的练习文件，看每个人的分数趋势、常犯问题和故事素材，逐题写批注、标出要重练的题，再一键导出批注发回给学生。数据只保存在你这台电脑上。

Import students' files, review trends, issues and stories, annotate answer by answer, flag redos, and export notes back. Data stays on this computer.

HOW THE INTERVIEWER THINKS

问题、追问、再追问。Question, follow-up, follow-up again.

这套逻辑来自师说顾问的 InitialView 辅导方法：回答里每出现一个新名词、一项活动或一个观点，就假设面试官会追问“你具体做了什么、为什么、有什么证据、难在哪、现在怎么看”。

It follows how CMC counselors coach InitialView: every new noun, activity or opinion in an answer is something a real interviewer will dig into. What did you do, why, how do you know, what was hard, how do you see it now.

LISTEN

读回答Read the answer

抓出新名词、活动和观点；数具体细节、“I”与“we”、填充词和套话。Pick out new nouns, activities and opinions; count specifics, "I" vs "we", fillers and clichés.

JUDGE

判深度Judge depth

给本题打四个信号：具体性、深度、主体性、清晰度。同一话题追问超过两层且答得扎实，就准备转题。Four signals per answer: specificity, depth, ownership, clarity. After two solid follow-ups on a topic, it moves on.

DECIDE

选动作Pick a move

probe 深挖 · clarify 要例子 · pivot 借你的话转题 · close 收尾留补充时间。probe to dig in · clarify to ask for an example · pivot using your own words · close with time for you to add anything.

ASK

开口问Ask like a person

一次只问一个问题，像真人一样说话：用缩略语、先对你说的内容做出反应，不说“Great question”这类 AI 腔。One question at a time, like a person: contractions, a reaction to what you said, no "Great question" filler.

顾问在环Counselor in the loop

  • 报告先给顾问：顾问审定后，再和学生一起复盘。Reports go to the counselor first, then get reviewed with the student.
  • 不背逐字稿：练的是“素材系统”，每个故事准备好三层追问。No memorized scripts: you build a set of stories, each ready for three layers of follow-up.
  • 不代写：改写只用学生自己说过的事实，缺细节处标出【补充】。No ghost-writing: rewrites only use facts the student said; missing details are marked.
  • 只用于练习：系统从不在真实面试中监听、作答或提示。Practice only: it never listens to, answers or prompts during a real interview.

真人外教形象Real-looking interviewers

  • 和真实录像一致：InitialView 录像里面试官只以照片 + 声音出现，我们照此设计，学生画面为主。Like a real recording: the interviewer appears as a photo and a voice, and the student fills the frame.
  • 写实照片已内置：五位外教的照片是 AI 生成的虚构人物，打开即显示；也可以换成机构外教本人的照片。Built-in photos of fictional AI-generated interviewers; you can swap in your own staff photos.
  • 真人感语音：自动选用最自然的声音：Edge 自带的神经网络声音，或在设置里接入 Gemini（免费 Key）/ OpenAI 自然语音。录像会同时录下外教声音和字幕。Picks the most natural voice available (Edge neural voices, or Gemini / OpenAI in Settings). Recordings include the interviewer's voice and captions.
  • 数字人视频（可选）：上传 HeyGen 等工具做的“倾听 + 说话”两段视频，外教开口时自动切换。Optional: upload "listening" and "talking" clips made with a tool like HeyGen.
